metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Canonical Metadata (v1.2)
metadata.description: Unified metadata descriptor for all FFT AI Edition modules, including identity, versioning, categories, roles, agent-readiness, harmonic support, drift recovery, and v1.2 compatibility.

module_categories.core: Foundational conceptual primitives (types, regimes, invariants, minimal operators).
module_categories.specification: Full conceptual definitions including structures, types, operators, invariants, validation profiles.
module_categories.registry: Canonical index of all FFT AI Edition modules.
module_categories.execution: Conceptual execution graph defining operator and regime flow.
module_categories.runtime: Execution configuration including routing, drift recovery, harmonic escalation.
module_categories.autonomy: Autonomy tiers, behavioral constraints, paradox escalation, drift recovery.
module_categories.capabilities: Tiered capability ontology for FFT agents.
module_categories.integrations: Cross-system integration bindings for external AI frameworks.
module_categories.discovery: Discovery protocol for autonomous and distributed agents.
module_categories.bootstrap: Multi-phase bootstrap sequence for initializing FFT.
module_categories.substrate: Hardware-ready conceptual substrate including multi-kernel support.
module_categories.hardware: Hardware capability profile for conceptual accelerators.
module_categories.rtt: RTT engines, prompts, and Spine examples.

module_roles.fft.ai.core: Provides minimal conceptual primitives required by all higher layers.
module_roles.fft.ai.spec: Defines full conceptual structures, types, operators, invariants, and validation profiles.
module_roles.fft.ai.registry: Enumerates all modules and provides canonical indexing.
module_roles.fft.ai.execution.graph: Defines conceptual flow for operators, regimes, and drift/harmonic routing.
module_roles.fft.ai.runtime: Controls execution, routing, drift recovery, and harmonic escalation.
module_roles.fft.ai.autonomy: Defines agent autonomy tiers and behavioral constraints.
module_roles.fft.ai.capabilities: Defines capability ontology and activation conditions.
module_roles.fft.ai.integrations: Maps FFT concepts to external AI frameworks.
module_roles.fft.ai.bootstrap: Initializes FFT in multi-phase conceptual bootloader.
module_roles.fft.ai.substrate: Defines conceptual hardware substrate and kernels.
module_roles.fft.ai.hardware.profile: Declares hardware capability profile for conceptual accelerators.
module_roles.fft.ai.rtt.spine.examples: Provides RTT Spine examples for clarity, drift, paradox, harmonic evaluation.

compatibility.notes: Metadata aligns with manifest, registry, autonomy, runtime, execution graph, substrate, and hardware profile v1.2.
